exact: negative regulation of response to immune interferon
negative regulation of response to interferon-gamma
broad: negative regulation of response to type II IFN
related: negative regulation of response to gamma-interferon

definition: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency or extent of a response to type II interferon (interferon-gamma). Response to interferon gamma is a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of an interferon-gamma stimulus.
label: negative regulation of response to type II interferon
